screen_names_and_descriptions: 21c267ef898a5960eea0d8cc0c93ea6eb54b46d154921ccbd6255d36be1f406f - Start state: This is the start state before any app screen is shown. No visible UI elements or controls are provided in the supplied information. No user action can be identified from this state.

63d674a04cf3c21f77f2bf42224283d198e6353093baa857bdf6a45e3a2e24e6 - GrantPermissionsActivity: This permission dialog asks whether Field Book can access photos, media, and files on the device. It shows a permission icon, the message text, and a progress indicator reading "1 of 4". The user can choose DENY or ALLOW to control access for this permission request.

e8a7712ad649e9ece119057d90bb9c0e27823671d4f030a791d0ceec2fa7ccb0 - ConfigActivity(Window=Main): This screen is a confirmation dialog titled "Sample data". It asks "Load sample data?" inside a scrollable message area. The user can respond with NO or YES to decide whether sample data should be loaded.

3fd19a77a22e0c2dd895fb1306d955120107d33b0b5cc2da987e11b06d1f2202 - ConfigActivity(Window=Main): This configuration screen has a toolbar labeled "Changelog" and a list of main sections. The list shows entries with icons for Fields, Traits, Collect, Profile, Export, Settings, and About. The user can select one of these items to open that part of the app.

e4b636069deaa9c3477a5b93a9adc8057d7f10029d272d7ae5d9d2d128ffebe2 - PreferencesActivity(Window=Main): This is the Settings screen with a Navigate up button in the action bar and a search field labeled "Search…" at the top. Below the search area is a scrollable list of settings categories: Profile, General, Appearance, Behavior, Sounds, BrAPI, and Database. The user can search for preferences or open any category from the list.

eb11e43fb68de36fde35b98680b866cdc44aca80736896e3c983dde1de1c1c87 - End state: This is the end state after the interaction flow finishes. No visible UI elements or actions are provided for this state. It does not describe an interactive application screen.

9d602f06efc565801b49d10ecb55f97bab99572627ad6d6ab9fe748ad79accf2 - PreferencesActivity(Window=Main): This settings subpage is titled "Database" and includes a Navigate up button in the action bar. The list contains three options: Import database, Export database, and Delete database. The user can choose one of these actions to manage the app database.

5d2c40f09fca8fcc98f3bc453fdf60ca1a498c2f702519cbecab887297ebaa69 - FileExploreActivity(Window=Main): This file selection screen is titled "Import database". It displays a list of available files, with "sample.db" shown as a selectable item. The user can browse the list and pick a database file to import.

cb0f0cd354757cd0636bed275a4743138d0a45a00ae70973e865ef321451a726 - PreferencesActivity(Window=Main): This settings page is titled "BrAPI Syncing Info" and includes a Navigate up button. It shows a preference for "BrAPI Base URL" with the summary "The base URL for the connected BrAPI server" and another option labeled "Authorize BrAPI". The user can review the server URL setting or start BrAPI authorization from this screen.

42c6b5fb9a5c5654d52518f6b9f74132d9dff4130e307c86b33258e9dd8865c2 - PreferencesActivity(Window=Main): This settings page is titled "General" and includes a Navigate up button with a scrollable list of general preferences. It shows options for Default import source and Default export source, both currently marked "Not set," plus several checkbox preferences such as Next entry with no data, Move to entry via barcode, Datagrid, Disable file sharing, and Move to unique identifier. The user can open source settings or toggle the listed behavior options on or off.

b3b693a45972474a4cc1bb2970f3e69020932dbb869e2f3dfcb140c84713395d - PreferencesActivity(Window=Main): This settings subpage is titled "Profile" and includes a Navigate up button. It displays two selectable items with icons: Person and Location. The user can open these options to manage profile-related information.

251d77b2465948d116f68ee4b08b494489804ba826f75ff914ee6fe06ae279a6 - ConfigActivity(Window=Main): This dialog is titled "Set location" and provides two text input fields labeled Longitude and Latitude. It also includes three buttons: GET LOCATION, CANCEL, and SAVE. The user can enter coordinates manually, request the current location, cancel the dialog, or save the location values.

73093ac1faaa0554e8b595c07db5b9b7f1d53d6bc66eaff90ad10b52a8b86a5b - NexusLauncherActivity(Window=Main): This is the Android home screen rather than an in-app Field Book screen. It shows the date widget, a page indicator, app shortcuts for Phone, Messages, Play Store, and Chrome, plus a Google search bar with voice search. The user can open apps, access the apps list, or use search from the launcher.

00fca957304975dd855eeb8d7e092015d67f30e6ea04cd725715f5fbec018020 - NexusLauncherActivity(Window=Main): This is the Android app drawer screen with an apps list and a search bar. It shows predicted apps including Photos, Play Store, Settings, Files, and Field Book, and the full list includes items such as Calculator, Calendar, Camera, Chrome, Clock, Contacts, Drive, Duo, Field Book, and others. The user can search, scroll through apps, or launch Field Book or another installed app.

6170babbc924d8aac7c6d53e3b5147a8cc6c0cd3d9769b658966afc5eb460910 - TraitEditorActivity(Window=Main): This screen is titled "Traits" and includes a Navigate up button along with action bar options for Visibility, Add trait, and More options. The main area contains a list view for traits and a separate newTrait image button. The user can browse traits, change visibility-related settings, add a new trait, or open additional options.

16c9d62c265c8fdb4e439859c356403676619f27ba36b7df23aeaf444ab30cd4 - CollectActivity(Window=Main): This collection screen contains a toolbar with a Navigate up button, selector controls, a trait picker with left and right navigation arrows, and a trait details label. It also shows range and plot labels and values, a trait input area, and a counter widget displaying the current value with -1 and +1 buttons. The bottom toolbar provides buttons for marking a missing value or deleting a value while the user records trait data.

e9baf7bd2356f52876be906bce06fe0d645bf7d061dc6158d90b0e4cfb1b20a6 - tracker): This is a system crash dialog stating "Field Book keeps stopping." It provides two buttons: App info and Close app. The user can inspect application information or dismiss the crashed app.

ce996774150c3ad1f0f6bd94bb14a65d4a876aff03eb142ea101b9eef83e4b49 - FieldEditorActivity(Window=Main): This screen is titled "Fields" and includes a Navigate up button and an action bar item labeled "Add trait." The main content area contains a list view for fields. The user can review the field list or use the action bar option to start importing or adding field-related data.

c9eaa367ac825ffaf903e98254a038e6bd7bc2b5cb3f84d70a7a6d3036965898 - FieldEditorActivity(Window=Main): This dialog is titled "Import field" and presents a list of import sources. The available options shown are Local storage, Cloud storage, and BrAPI. The user can choose a source for importing field data or press CANCEL to close the dialog.

2e24fc20385d44bccc827cfc1187b8b6a70d8baf69318294a0f772a1fb4f7f17 - FileExploreActivity(Window=Main): This file browser is titled "Import field" and shows a list of CSV files. The visible file options are field_sample.csv, field_sample2.csv, field_sample3.csv, and test1.csv. The user can browse and select one of these files to import field data.

c4115ce2f055969c5a8450a4ae776bb9f0aaad15e534ac215ca60ce9e6d232a2 - FieldEditorActivity(Window=Main): This dialog is titled "Import field" and asks the user to map columns before importing. It provides spinners for Unique identifier, Primary order, and Secondary order, each currently showing "header1" as the selected value. The user can choose the appropriate columns and then press IMPORT to bring the field data into the app.

7b6817e119fb8db3c9a19fc6fec271fa3bf2f88bc0a0454121caa77efe9623d4 - FieldEditorActivity(Window=Main): This Fields screen shows a list containing at least one imported field entry. The visible item includes a radio button, a popup menu button, the field name "test1," an import date of "2022-07-10," and a count value of "1." The user can select the field, open its popup menu, or navigate within the field list.

18e0a03ff2826075207970099afe784532f2acd959bd989928fbb4e43a698187 - FieldEditorActivity(Window=Popup Menu): This popup menu shows a simple list of three selectable items. The visible options are header1, header2, and header3. The user can choose one of these values from the menu.

71ef7eff024402b75d00aa2bdaf606ad9d46048be38fe85d681ed685dd7cc19c - FieldEditorActivity(Window=Popup Menu): This popup menu displays three list items for selection. The options shown are header1, header2, and header3. The user can tap one of these items to make a selection.
